title: Wow!
scene: Max shows Anna his new flat, and she reacts to everything: 'wow' at the view, 'ah' and 'huh?' at a strange lamp, 'oho' and 'ooh la la' at his new jacket, 'OMG' and 'caramba' at the mess in the kitchen, 'voila!' says Max when he opens the fridge, and 'eureka!' when he finds his lost keys.

words.ex: Wow, your new car is great!
Ah, now I understand!
Huh? What is it?
Oho, so that's where you hid the cookies!
Ooh la la, you look great in that dress!
OMG, I just passed my driving test!
Caramba, I forgot my keys again!
Add hot water, stir, and voila, soup is ready!
"Eureka! I finally found my car keys!" she shouted.

title: Oops!
scene: A bad morning for Taras: 'oops' - he drops his phone, 'brr' - the bathroom is cold, 'feh' - the soup is cold too, 'fie!' says Grandpa like an old king in a film, and 'boo!' - his sister jumps out from behind the door. Only Mama's pancakes make him say 'mmm'.

words.ex: Oops, I dropped my phone again.
Brr, it's really cold outside today!
"Feh, this soup is cold," she said.
"Fie on you!" shouted the old king.
"Boo!" he shouted from behind the door.
Mmm, this soup is really good.

title: Ha-ha!
scene: The family watches a comedy together, and everyone laughs in a different way: Dad with a short 'ha' and then a loud 'ha-ha-ha', Anna with a quiet 'heh', Taras with 'ha-ha' and 'hehe' in his messages, the little cousins with 'hee-hee', and Grandpa with 'ho-ho' and a Santa 'ho-ho-ho'.

words.ex: Ha! That's so funny!
Ha-ha-ha, that joke was really funny!
Heh, that is a really funny joke.
Ha-ha, that's the funniest joke I've heard today!
She texted me "hehe" after my silly joke.
"Hee-hee," the little girl laughed behind her hand.
"Ho-ho, what do we have here?" he said.
Santa laughed "ho-ho-ho" and gave out the gifts.

title: Stop! Bravo!
scene: Words people shout: a guard shouts 'stop!', a friend whispers 'psst', a teacher jokes 'achtung!', Mama says 'basta!', a pilot calls 'mayday' and sailors send an SOS - and happy crowds shout 'bravo', 'bravissimo', 'ole' and 'vivat', and soldiers in an old film shout 'banzai'.

words.ex: Stop! The light is red.
Psst, come over here and look at this!
"Achtung!" he shouted as a joke before his announcement.
Basta! I don't want to hear any more.
The pilot shouted mayday into the radio.
The sailors sent an SOS when the engine failed.
Bravo! That was a beautiful song.
The audience stood up and shouted "Bravissimo!"
The crowd shouted "olé!" at every good pass.
The crowd shouted "Vivat!" when the king appeared.
The soldiers shouted "Banzai!" and ran forward.

title: Meow, moo, bam!
scene: A noisy day in Grandma's village: the kitten says 'meow', the cow says 'moo', a door goes 'bam', a car goes 'beep-beep', the old clock goes 'tick-tack', and Grandma sings 'la-la', 'la-la-la' and 'tra-la-la' in the kitchen.

words.ex: "Meow," said the kitten when it wanted food.
The cow looked at us and said, "Moo!"
Bam! The door closed hard behind me.
"Beep-beep!" the car horn went outside.
Tick-tack, the old clock in the hall kept going.
She forgot the words, so she sang "la-la."
She forgot the words and just sang "la-la-la."
She sang "tra-la-la" while cooking dinner.

title: GG!
scene: Taras plays an online game with friends. They type 'LOL' and 'kek' in the chat, one friend shouts 'bazinga' after a silly joke, the screen says 'game over', everyone writes 'GG', and Mama says it is all blah blah blah.

words.ex: LOL, your photo of the cat is so funny!
Kek, that meme is so funny.
"Bazinga!" he shouted after his silly joke.
Game over, do you want to play again?
After the match, everyone typed GG in the chat.
He talked about work all evening, blah blah blah.

title: Ciao! Hello around the world
scene: Anna collects ways to greet people and say goodbye from her trips and friends: 'ciao' and 'arrivederci' in Italy, 'adios' in Mexico, 'adieu' in Paris, 'aloha' in Hawaii, 'konnichiwa' and 'sayonara' in Japan, and 'namaste' and 'namaskar' in India.

words.ex: Ciao, see you tomorrow at work!
He waved and said "arrivederci" as he left the restaurant.
Adios, everyone, see you next week!
She said adieu and left the room.
The hotel staff greeted us with "Aloha!"
In Japan, people say konnichiwa to greet each other.
Sayonara, everyone, and see you next week!
The yoga teacher said namaste at the end of class.
"Namaskar," she said and put her hands together.

title: Words of faith and peace
scene: At an evening of many faiths Anna hears words people use every day: 'shalom' and 'salaam' to wish peace, 'inshallah' and 'alhamdulillah' from her Muslim friend, and 'alleluia' and 'Ave Maria' from the church choir.

words.ex: He said "shalom" when he walked in.
He greeted his neighbor with a warm salaam.
"See you tomorrow?" "Inshallah, I'll be there."
"How are you?" "Alhamdulillah, I'm fine, thank you."
The choir sang "Alleluia" at the end of the service.
The choir sang the "Ave Maria" softly at the end.
